```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Assuming the dataset is in a file called 'data.csv'
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Convert 'StichtagDat' to datetime
df['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(df['StichtagDat'])

# Melt the dataframe to create separate columns for year, month and dog characteristics
df_melted = pd.melt(df, id_vars=['StichtagDat', 'DatenstandCd', 'HID', 'KreisCd', 'KreisLang', 'QuarCd', 'QuarLang'], value_vars=['AlterV10Cd', 'AlterVHundCd', 'SexCd', 'SexHundCd', 'AnzHunde'])

# Plot the data using seaborn
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.lineplot(data=df_melted, x='StichtagDat', y='value', hue='variable', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Dog Characteristics Over Time')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend(title='Characteristic')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.savefig('output.png')
```
